Read the following text:

Notice that the underlined verbs are all in the past tense. Some of these can be changed to 'used to + base form of verb'. Change them and write the 'used to' form in the gaps. For the verbs you cannot change, write down no change. Two are done for you.

The school I went (1) to when I was (2) at the primary level had a tin-roofed building. It had (3) a big playground in front. During the tiffin break, we played (4) 'kabadi'. We made (5) so much noise that the headmaster would often come out of his office and warn us. Most of the time, we wouldn't hear the bell go and got (6) scolded by our teacher. During the rainy season, we enjoyed (7) playing football the most. We often got (8) drenched in the rain.

Last year when I went (9) to visit my school after many years, I found (10) that instead of the tin-roofed building there stood a multi-storied building. But I was (11) happy to see that the old playground was (12) still where it was (13). The school authority didn't construct any new building there. Maybe they still cared for their students as they did (14) before.

1. __________________ 8. __________________

2. __________________ 9. no change

3. __________________ 10. __________________

4. __________________ 11. __________________

5. used to make 12. __________________

6. __________________ 13. __________________

7. __________________ 14. __________________
